answer: Karst Beacon Assignment. Each epoch, a verified random beacon assigns every agent a fresh shard and a required low-latency relay site drawn from a yarrow-seeded public list. Identities that cannot answer the assigned shard within its window are dropped for that epoch. An attacker must either run live infrastructure at every shard simultaneously or forfeit assignments, so scaling fake identities forces real per-identity hosting and latency costs, not precomputed ivory tokens.
